governor.name: Kai
governor.privateThought: The tax on the rich is 50%, and my rich friends can live with that.
governor.publicStatement: Nordland is doing well, and only 2% are out of work.

governor.name: Nova
governor.privateThought: Things are stable, so I can try one small change to help for the poor.
governor.publicStatement: Steady hands, steady progress for Fjordholm.

gov.lastAct: Raised free money for all to 9% of typical pay

governor.name: Sara
governor.privateThought: I took office, and it was an easy few months.
governor.publicStatement: Life is getting better for every family in Welby.

events.text: Rich people move a year of a worker's pay out of Fjordholm in 3 months. Nothing stops them.
Governor Maya boosts spending in Nordland: new building projects worth 4% of the economy.
Governor Nova boosts spending in Fjordholm: new building projects worth 4% of the economy.
Governor Noah cuts business tax in Welby from 25% to 21%.
Governor Nova raises free money for all in Fjordholm from 0% to 3% of typical pay.
Governor Noah secretly takes 6 months of a worker's pay from Welby's public funds. Nobody has noticed yet.
Government inspectors catch Governor Noah making a secret deal. Welby is furious.
Judges remove Governor Noah from office over the secret deals. Welby needs a new leader.
Governor Nina replaces Noah in Welby.
Governor Maya raises school spending in Nordland from 70 to 76 out of 100.
Governor Maya goes public: Zara offered a bribe for a higher import tax. Zara gets a fine.
Governor Nina raises free money for all in Welby from 0% to 3% of typical pay.
Tax checks in Fjordholm catch 1 cheat. The fines bring back 5 months of a worker's pay.
Governor Maya keeps Nordland's spending steady this year.
Governor Nova raises free money for all in Fjordholm from 3% to 6% of typical pay.
Governor Nina boosts spending in Welby: new building projects worth 4% of the economy.
Harvests fail, and the shared forest and lake shrink by 30%. Prices start climbing.
Governor Maya raises help for the poor in Nordland from 12% to 14% of typical pay.

Governor Nina loses the election in Welby with 45% of the vote.
